About Our Dojang

Fearless Taekwondo Dojang was founded with one mission — to forge not just skilled martial artists, but disciplined, honourable human beings. Our dojang is a sacred space where every student is treated with equal respect.

We train in the traditional Kukkiwon style of Taekwondo, preserving the authentic art form while embracing modern training. Every class, every poomsae, every sparring session is a step closer to your best self.

Located in Shankhamool, Lalitpur, our dojang runs classes Sunday to Friday — morning sessions from 6AM to 8AM and evening sessions from 5PM to 7PM. Membership is by invitation — submit your CV to the Master Rojin Bamjan will review your application.

우리 사범님
The Master
Master Rojin Bamjan
Grand Master · Kukkiwon Black Belt · 15+ Years Experience

Master Rojin Bamjan is a proud Nepali martial artist who has dedicated over 15 years to the art of Taekwondo. Born and raised in Nepal, he began his journey in the dojang at a young age and rose through every belt rank with unwavering discipline and passion.

He founded Fearless Taekwondo Dojang in Shankhamool, Lalitpur with a single mission — to bring world-class Taekwondo training to Nepal and develop warriors of both body and character. He believes every student deserves access to authentic, disciplined martial arts education.

"In Taekwondo, the foot and the fist are weapons. But the mind and the spirit are the true masters."

document.getElementById('editErr').classList.remove('show'); document .getElementById('editMemberModal') .classList.add('active'); } function closeEditMember() { document .getElementById('editMemberModal') .classList.remove('active'); } function saveEditMember() { const uid = document.getElementById('editMemberId').value; const fn = document.getElementById('eFN').value.trim(); const ln = document.getElementById('eLN').value.trim(); const em = document.getElementById('eEM').value.trim(); const ph = document.getElementById('ePH').value.trim(); const bt = document.getElementById('eBT').value; const pw = document.getElementById('ePW').value.trim(); const du = parseFloat(document.getElementById('eDU').value) || 0; const dd = document.getElementById('eDD').value; const ddesc = document.getElementById('eDDesc').value.trim(); const dpaid = document.getElementById('eDPaid').checked; const errEl = document.getElementById('editErr'); if (!fn || !ln || !em) { errEl.textContent = 'First name, last name and email are required.'; errEl.classList.add('show'); return; } const users = DB.getUsers(); const u = users.find((x) => x.id === uid); if (!u) return; u.firstName = fn; u.lastName = ln; u.name = fn + ' ' + ln; u.email = em; u.phone = ph; u.belt = bt; if (pw) u.password = pw; DB.setUsers(users); const dues = DB.getDues(); dues[uid] = { amount: du, dueDate: dd, description: ddesc || 'Monthly Training Fee', paid: dpaid, }; DB.setDues(dues); closeEditMember(); renderAdminMembers(); renderPublicMembers(); renderAdminOverview(); } document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { document .getElementById('editMemberModal') .addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === this) closeEditMember();
